segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or puffy under-eyes report the cream helps moisturize and plump the area, even when it does not resolve puffiness on its own.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive eyes or skin, including some sensitive to Vitamin C or fragrance, report no irritation or reaction, though one reviewer felt mild discomfort for a few minutes after each application.
segments.mature: One reviewer recommends the product specifically for mature skin after seeing gradual results.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report mixed results on fine lines and plumping: some say fine lines visibly soften within a few weeks, while many others report no noticeable change despite consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the eye cream provides strong, lasting hydration to the under-eye area, describing it as the product's most reliable benefit even when plumping claims fall short.

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am probably most self-conscious about my under eye area. I have hereditary dark circles and hollowness. Filler appeals to me but I've heard horror stories so I'm a little scared to get it, haha. I was excited to receive this product for free. While I know there's not a topical product that's gonna truly give filler-like results, I was hopeful for some slight improvement. Unfortunately I didn't see any change after using this product for a few weeks. I like that it's not too thick or sticky, and I like the ingredients. I didn't have any reaction to it (I have very sensitive eyes) so that was a plus.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm always looking for great skincare, so I was excited to try out this eye cream! This one, though, while good, didn't wow me. For context, I have fair, sensitive skin as well as sensitivities to scents. THE PROS: -solid ingredient list -pump packaging -no detectable scent -hydrating -a small amount goes a long way THE CONS: -I exhibited mild discomfort for about 5 minutes after each application. Not sure if this was supposed to be a cooling sensation that so many eye creams try to do, but it wasn't comfortable for me. -it didn't absorb very easily for me. I had to keep working it into my skin for more time than I would have liked. -I haven't noticed any significant changes in my skin after 3 weeks of use. Overall, I think it's a good option if you don't have sensitive skin and you're looking for extra hydration under the eyes.
